cues.text: In the dorm's command room. Mitsuru stands at the bank of monitors with her back to the rest of you: Akihiko, you, Yukari and Junpei stand behind her, Akihiko and Junpei with their hands on their hips.
Akihiko and Mitsuru turn and walk out of the room; a door opens and shuts behind them. You, Yukari and Junpei stay where you are.
